title: UCQM: A Six-Metric Quality Framework for Continuous-Variable Cluster States
summary: Continuous-variable (CV) cluster states constitute one of the central resources for measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC). Despite substantial progress in their theoretical development and experimental realization, comparing the quality of different cluster-state topologies remains challenging, as existing approaches typically rely either on qualitative inspection of covariance matrices or on individual metrics that characterize only a single aspect of the underlying correlation structure.
